title: Profiles, Privacy and Records
body: Profiles are public. Edit Showcase opens private controls for earned badges and owned collectibles. Activity visibility hides message, word, voice and most-used statistics together; game, economy and achievement statistics remain public. Weekly ties award each co-winner. Triple Threat permanently occupies the premium showcase slot once earned. Records have monthly and all-time periods; monthly records reset on the first at 4 AM Mountain.

steps: Choose activity and roast preferences independently.
